_doc: Spakarna i Asset Studios avdelning The Character Creator (studio/human.js, docs/asset-studio.md). Makrona hamnar överst i make_human-receptet, reglagen med "in": "sliders" under sliders (namnen och målen i human_sliders.json; ett reglage som finns där men saknas här läggs till av servern med sin etikett). Etiketter och hjälptexter på engelska (appen). Mallarna är startrecept med en ikon i assets/icons/human/<id>.png.

params.label: Sex
params.help: 0 is a woman, 1 a man; in between mixes the two. Above 0.5 the male game mesh (male1591) is used

params.label: Age
params.help: Age in years (adults only, 18 and up)

params.label: Muscle
params.help: Muscle tone over the whole body

params.label: Weight
params.help: Body fat over the whole body

params.label: Height
params.help: Body height (0.5 is average for the sex and age)

params.label: Bust shape
params.help: From round, like a ball (-1), to pointed (+1): MakeHuman's breast-point targets

params.label: Pubic mound
params.help: A small rise in front of the pubic bone and a shallow crease at the groin, along the mesh normals (1 = 9 mm rise, 3 mm crease)

params.label: Arm angle
params.help: The arms in the posed copy (_pose.glb), in degrees from the body: 90 is a T-pose, 45 an A-pose. The rigged figure keeps its rest pose

params.label: Arms forward
params.help: The arms swung forward in the posed copy, in degrees (the fit sets it to match the AI shape)

params.label: Leg spread
params.help: The legs out from the plumb line in the posed copy, in degrees

options.label: 12.7k tris
options.help: The game mesh subdivided once (about 12,700 triangles), the standard

options.label: 3.2k tris
options.help: The game mesh as it is (about 3,200 triangles), for crowds and far away

templates.label: Elder
templates.help: An older man with a softer middle

fit.label: Wrap to the shape
fit.sub: pull the game mesh tight to the AI surface
fit.help: After the sliders, the exported game mesh is pulled tight against the AI surface (hands, feet and eyes stay); off gives sliders only

fit.label: Symmetric
fit.sub: mirror the fit left and right
fit.help: Bodies are symmetric: the sliders and the wrap are mirrored

fit.label: Ignore hair
fit.sub: the AI shape has hair: scale from the neck
fit.help: For an AI shape with hair: the scale comes from the neck instead of the full height, the surface above the brows is not measured, the scalp keeps MPFB's shape and the neck and back are pulled only within 2 cm

fit.label: Fine passes
fit.sub: two finer steps at the end
fit.help: Two finer Gauss-Newton steps after the coarse ones (slower, a closer fit)

paint._doc: Modellerna för Generate this view i målningen (studio/human_paint.js, /api/human/genview), via OpenRouter. price visas i appen innan något beställs. gpt-image-2 och Qwen Image 3 nekade 2026-11-10 en kropp i underkläder (moderation); local/krea-2 körs med tools/texture/krea2.py --base (bild till bild) och kostar inget.

models.label: Krea-2 (local, free)
models.help: Krea-2 Turbo on ComfyUI (Darrowmere or the laptop) repaints the render picture-to-picture: no filter and the framing stays, but it does not see the reference pictures (the prompt comes from the figure's order)

models.label: Qwen Image 3
models.help: Strong at editing with several input pictures, keeps the layout

models.label: Krea K3 Edit
models.help: Krea's edit model (the concepts are Krea-2)

models.label: FLUX 3
models.help: Black Forest Labs, several reference pictures

order.label: Order a character on Darrowmere
order.help: New reference pictures and AI models (Krea, Pixal3D, Tripo, Meshy) are ordered on Darrowmere's control panel

editor.label: Open the Body Editor
editor.help: The mesh editor for the bodies (body-gen), in its own window on the RTX card
